name: MBPO Broadway Storefront Vacancy Survey 2020
description:
This dataset contains the results of a 2020 survey of storefront vacancies along Broadway in Manhattan, with 385 sampled records and 15 fields. Each row describes a surveyed location, including its street address, the business name where one was present, what indicated the vacancy (such as "For Rent/For Lease," "Empty," "Closed Until Further Notice," "Covered Windows," or "Permanently Closed"), whether the storefront was boarded up, and which side of the street it is on. Records are geocoded with latitude and longitude and linked to administrative areas including community board, council district, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area (NTA), borough, and postcode, plus building and lot identifiers (BIN and BBL). About 46% of rows lack a business name, and roughly 2% are missing geographic fields.

The data can be used to map and analyze storefront vacancy patterns along a major commercial corridor, compare vacancy conditions across neighborhoods, council
